entities.name: Imam Al-Tayeb Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Imam Al-Tayeb Mosque, is located in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates within the Abrahamic Family House interfaith complex alongside a synagogue and a Catholic church. It was inaugurated on 16 February 2023. The mosque is named after the Grand Imam of Al-Azhar, Ahmed El-Tayeb.
